shared_elements: schematic figures rendered in flat profile/silhouette
a horizontal line or band on which figures stand or are aligned
paired/repeated figures of the same type side by side
stone as the ground of the image
curved, hook-like terminals (boat prows / animal heads and beaks)
justification: Both place repeated, highly schematic profile figures upright along a strong horizontal baseline or band, which is the most specific correspondence, and both reduce bodies to flat, outline-free shapes with hooked extremities. But A is a two-figure red painted silhouette on an unworked granite face, while B is a dense, multi-register carved relief crowded with animals and patterned bands, so the technique, subject matter and compositional density are fundamentally different.
